changes.summary: Integration tests no longer hard-fail when BARONG_TEST_DB_READY is missing. They warn and skip gracefully. DB-backed fixture setup also skips instead of connecting to the default db:5432 URL when no safe test DATABASE_URL is configured.
Example/test Postgres now uses barong_test_example credentials/database and explicit db/postgres network aliases. Backend DATABASE_URL points at the compose test DB service.
Temporary Docker Postgres launched by the integration test runner now includes Docker healthcheck configuration.
Docker backend DB test runner now uses backend/pytest.ini and exports BARONG_TEST_DB_READY=1 after Alembic migration before DB-backed pytest execution.
Backend integration CI now waits for PostgreSQL with a psycopg connect/select loop before Alembic and pytest.
Foundation demo DB-backed module tests are explicitly marked integration.
n8n DB-backed module tests are explicitly marked integration.
